entities.summary: Tohorot is the sixth and last order of the Mishnah. This order deals with the clean/unclean distinction and family purity. This is the longest of the orders in the Mishnah. There are 12 tractates:Keilim: ; deals with a large array of various utensils and how they fare in terms of purity. 30 chapters, the longest in the Mishnah.
